Snapshot ownership remains independent across end/begin/reset; off/on immutable traces coexist at<=2MiB encoded each. Previous snapshot headers, frames, counters and decode closures cannot be overwritten by next capture.
No eager full trace arrays, retained decoded payload cache or extra index vectors; streamed comparisons and source lookups keep at most two complete trace rows live.
All original helper/RNG, tuple/result, source duplicate-occurrence, freeze/chooser ordering, input purity, full output/RNG and typed observer-catch assertions remain meaningful.
Exact header/frame/tag/count/length/UTF8/JSON-shape verification and canonical recompression byte comparison; malformed, extra, concatenated, corrupted or noncanonical streams fail closed.
Explicit maxOutputLength supplied before compression/inflation; codec/allocation errors sticky and distinct from deliberate observer faults and resource overflow.

majorLessons: A representation budget amendment must state the old and new predicates explicitly; equal numeric caps do not make them equivalent.
